records.title: 10-K
records.text: Net sales in fiscal 2025 increased by 7.7% to $5.55 billion, from $5.15 billion in fiscal 2024.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: Comparable retail store net sales increased as a result of higher store traffic and transactions, which were partially offset by a decrease in units per transaction.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: Inventory as of January 31, 2025 and 2024 totaled $621.1 million and $550.2 million, representing 13.7% and 13.4% of total assets, respectively.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: The deleverage in selling, general and administrative expenses as a rate to sales was primarily related to increased marketing expenses to support customer growth and increased sales in the Retail and Subscription segments.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: Income from operations for fiscal 2025 was 8.5% of net sales, or $473.8 million, compared to 7.2% of net sales, or $369.8 million, for fiscal 2024.
